Source_text includes title? It says source_text includes "Doesn’t charge well.\nPlugged..." So yes. evidence_span "Doesn’t charge well." exact. primary function_performance secondary charging_success polarity negative.

Claim 2: "Plugged in my phone and a small desk fan ... and my phone still had 6% by morning even though it was plugged in all night." This indicates charging failed to charge phone overnight, possibly due sharing with fan? This is charging_success negative. Maybe charging_speed? No.

Need exact continuous substring. Could choose evidence span "Doesn’t charge well." That's sufficient. But body adds detail. The claim semantic is charging failure. One claim maybe enough. "Doesn't charge well" could be general_performance but specifically charging success. The body "phone still had 6% by morning even though it was plugged in all night" is definitely charging_success (failed to charge). I'd choose charging_success.

Maybe include second claim for "my phone still had 6% by morning even though it was plugged in all night." It is a distinct evidence supporting same claim. But as extraction, maybe one claim with body evidence. The title is summary. We can extract one claim using body evidence to be precise.
